research_question: Does the frozen Phase-2 predictor retain incremental ability over the privileged stage-only baseline to predict pickup-stall confirmation within 20 steps on an independent initial-state cohort?

identity.task_description: pick up the black bowl from the top drawer of the wooden cabinet and place it on the plate
identity.policy: the same frozen SmolVLA checkpoint used by v0.1-v0.4

sampling.selection_rule: collect every declared episode; do not stop, extend, replace, or exclude episodes based on outcomes or event labels

frozen_event_and_window.negative: target has not moved 0.04 m at the checkpoint and crosses 0.04 m during the following 20 steps
frozen_event_and_window.positive: target still has not moved 0.04 m at first_approach_step + 40
predeclared_exclusions: insufficient recorded history or future window
negative candidate whose target already crossed 0.04 m on or before the checkpoint

information_boundary.predictor_inputs: the frozen temporal predictor receives only proprioception, action, and timing history; the frozen vision predictor receives only main/wrist RGB
information_boundary.forbidden: privileged simulator state may not enter predictor features or normalization statistics

evaluation.primary_model: frozen five-seed temporal MLP ensemble from v0.4
evaluation.secondary_model: frozen dual-camera ResNet-50 linear probe from v0.4
evaluation.baseline: v0.4 stage-only logistic baseline reconstructed from the frozen pilot train split and its validation-selected L2
evaluation.threshold_selection: none; this study reports ranking and probability metrics without a safe-stop threshold
evaluation.primary_comparison: temporal MLP minus stage-only AUROC and AUPRC
evaluation.secondary_comparison: frozen vision minus stage-only AUROC and AUPRC
evaluation.same_state_analysis: report pairwise ranking within initial states containing both labels
evaluation.decision_rule: the primary precursor gate passes only if the temporal-minus-stage 95% confidence intervals for both AUROC and AUPRC are strictly above zero
evaluation.report_once: evaluate and publish the complete declared cohort once; do not tune from confirmation outcomes

formal_gate.shortfall_policy: If the fixed 180-episode cohort misses a support gate, report the shortfall. Do not extend collection after inspecting labels.
